label: The FY27 budget season
trigger: The annual cycle: Tri-Board meetings from July 2025, the Superintendent’s four scenarios on 25 February 2026, the School Committee’s vote on 18 March, the Annual Town Meeting on 2 May and the election on 16 May
outcome: Balanced budget adopted at Town Meeting; both override questions failed at the election
note: A Town Meeting is an event inside the season, not an episode of its own

label: Summer 2026 — the Governor’s budget and the FY27 extra state aid
trigger: After both override questions failed on 16 May 2026 the School Committee adopted the balanced budget and named its cuts; then the enacted FY27 state budget, signed 9 July, carried $471,121 more net aid than the town had budgeted, and the Select Board called a Special Town Meeting for 3 September to decide how to use it
outcome: Articles 1 and 3 approved, $418,000 to the schools (as heard in our minutes of the School Committee, 9 September 2026)
source: sources/analyses/fy27-and-the-override.md; our minutes of the School Committee and Select Board, May–September 2026
note: A spending plan, not a deficit: the figures in this window are how new money was allocated, after the cuts of June
